notes: Full description: pkix-lint/src/report.rs:244 contains a json_round_trip test gated on #[cfg(feature = "serde")]. The test is never executed by 'cargo test -p pkix-lint' (the default CI run), only by 'cargo test -p pkix-lint --features serde'. If the serde feature is not included in the standard CI matrix, the serialization of EvaluationReport can regress silently. Fix: add a CI matrix entry that runs 'cargo test -p pkix-lint --features serde' (or add it to a workspace-level test target). Alternatively, consider whether the json_round_trip test should be a separate integration test file that's only compiled when the serde feature is enabled, making the gating explicit and discoverable. Same concern applies to any serde-gated code in deviation.rs and lib.rs.
title: RUSTY: serde JSON test not run without --features serde
